svg.text: under the bundle, up through E012,
twist the two ends together on top
Where the wires cross column E, they get tied down. A tug then pulls on the lash, not on the solder joints.
Adapter out. 1) gather the seven wires where they pass column E, slide 3 cm of heat-shrink over them and shrink it (or wrap tape).
2) 10 cm of bare wire: push one end down through E004, bring it across the underside, up through E012, over the bundle, twist the ends. Trim.
